newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.

text.p: Ten stocks fell, seven rose and six were flat in 10.9-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Tuesday, with the WIG 20 index up 0.9 percent to 1,659.8 points.
In comparison with their main market fixing, 19 stocks rose, two fell and two were flat.
The remaining seven stocks did not trade.
The National Investment Fund NIF index rose one percent to 137.4 points in 2.1-million-zloty trade.
NFI units rose 0.4 percent to 135.5 zlotys in a 5.7-million-zloty turnover. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
